subject: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revisions
overview: The Rules and Policy Subcommittee met to review structural and content updates to the district's Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan. The committee voted to condense the document in consultation with legal counsel prior to its next meeting.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revisions
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed proposed revisions to the Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan, addressing updated legal definitions, false reporting distinctions, anonymous tip line integration, and moving historical background into an appendix. A motion passed to assign a member to condense the document with input from the school attorney ahead of the next meeting.
